Callout.Name: Missing Hiker
Callout.Advisory: Car still at the trailhead, weather turning.

Script.Line: Her car is at the trailhead and she has not come back.
She is fit. She has walked this trail a dozen times.
The weather is turning in tonight, so we are against the light.

Lines.Approach: Her car is still at the trailhead and the weather is coming in. That is all we have.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
